purpose: A provenance-bound offline NO-GO successor for published polarity and confidence aggregates.
limits: This is an offline descriptive diagnostic and remains a NO-GO for production polarity or rubric change.
The published polarity aggregate does not contain a four-state cross-tab, so this successor publishes a reducer policy rather than invented archived cell counts.
Confidence remains noncanonical; the archived equal-budget low-confidence allocation did not beat uniform allocation on its repeat-consensus proxy.
No output changes HBQ-RS scoring, coverage, leaves, ownership, weights, prompts, or runtime behavior.
privacy: Aggregate-only public source summaries; no prose, prompts, artifact identifiers, question identifiers, raw verdicts, sessions, or provider response text.
